fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (NasdaqGS:AMD) is expanding into the quantum computing field and focusing on commercial hybrid quantum-classical computing solutions such as drug discovery through new and expanded partnerships with PsiQuantum, IBM, and Oak Ridge National Laboratory.
fields.summary_ko.1: AMD is a large semiconductor company with a market cap of approximately $875.9 billion, supporting high-performance computing workloads using Versal FPGA, Instinct GPU, EPYC CPU, and ROCm stack.
fields.summary_ko.2: If quantum-related workloads are reflected in the performance of the data center segment and revenue contribution is disclosed, it would indicate that these collaborations are transitioning from the laboratory stage to commercial workloads.
